# Narvis 0.2.10
This hotfix makes phone pairing start reliably while the Narvis service is running.
- Narvis now pauses the Adapter service before generating a pairing QR code, waits for the shared connection lock to be released, and restores the service afterwards. - Pairing startup failures now show an actionable error instead of remaining indefinitely on “Starting Adapter…”. - “Regenerate” safely handles an active service before retrying. - Bundles the contract-verified Nothing Adapter 0.1.4 release.

# Narvis 0.2.9
This hotfix makes new phone pairings use the encrypted Noise protocol shipped in Nothing Adapter 0.1.4.
- Stops passing `--allow-insecure-plaintext` to Adapter 0.1.4 and newer. On these builds that flag explicitly downgrades pairing to the legacy plaintext path. - Keeps the flag only for adapters older than 0.1.4, where it was required for pairing to run at all. - Extends the DMG contract gate to verify that the bundled adapter exposes Noise pairing as the default and plaintext as an explicit opt-in.
Users with a pairing created before Noise should pair the phone again once. The new encrypted record is then used by subsequent service connections.

# Narvis 0.2.8
This release restores phone connectivity with the current encrypted handshake, and turns Update into one control for Narvis and Nothing Adapter.
- A single click updates an existing release or source-checkout Adapter before Narvis downloads, verifies, installs and relaunches through Sparkle. - Checks for Narvis and Adapter updates every five minutes and marks the shared Update control when either component has a newer version. - Keeps background checks informational: installation still requires the user to click Update, and a running Adapter service is safely restarted around an Adapter update. - Bundles contract-tested Nothing Adapter v0.1.4, including the Noise encrypted transport expected by current Ditto phone builds. The adapter is version-locked to commit `6d90a612` and switches atomically with Narvis. - Starts the service automatically after successful pairing, recovers orphaned service processes after an app update, and reads paired phones from sealed adapter configuration. - Avoids suggesting `/` or the home directory as one-click authorization roots, and can open the live service log in Terminal.
Node.js remains required to run Nothing Adapter. Existing release and source installations retain their native update paths, now coordinated by Narvis.

# Narvis 0.2.7
This maintenance release keeps the Session Island attached to the MacBook notch when the display layout changes.
- Repositions the resident Island trigger after a display is connected, disconnected, or rearranged. - Retracts an open Island during a display change, then recalculates its placement the next time it opens. - Keeps the signed one-click update flow, the restored Narvis app icon, and the contract-tested Nothing Adapter v0.1.1 bundle unchanged.

# Narvis 0.2.6
This maintenance release restores the Narvis app icon in the signed DMG and installed application. Narvis 0.2.5 could display the generic macOS document icon because the SwiftPM/Xcode release product did not copy `Narvis.icns` into the final app bundle.
- Bundles the dot-matrix Narvis icon in `Narvis.app/Contents/Resources`. - Declares the icon in the final signed app's `Info.plist`. - Restores Sparkle's complete updater runtime in clean source checkouts so the signed one-click updater is present in every reproducible release build. - Keeps the one-click Narvis update flow and the contract-tested Nothing Adapter v0.1.1 bundle unchanged.
